review.imagery: 38 gallery entries include 7 dated site photographs. All 26 primary assets, the entire 33-page brochure index, thirteen native resources and seven September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Three inferior facade/roof derivatives and native textures or repeated scenes were excluded. Eight brochure scenes add distinct lobby, bathroom, gym and dining details. Source pixels remain intact. The complete daylight building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All four original physical pages 2–5 were reviewed as whole sheets. Three openly displayed broker images were separately viewed at native size. They show one studio and two 1 BR previews without numerical areas. Remaining broker layouts are form-gated. Legends, margins, level grouping and original source links remain intact. Four complete level drawings and three attributed broker home previews are available. The previews supply no numerical saleable area. Their drawing positions do not establish contractual unit numbers. Confirm final areas and revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: The complete physical brochure page 14 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Each selected time follows its dashed destination line. Circle Mall has no separately printed estimate. No target coordinates were inferred from map-camera numbers.
review.provenance: Official HTML/gallery and September 2026 history pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Branded brochure and complete building drawings retain Mitchell’s broker-mirror attribution. Public unit previews, where available, retain their separately observed broker image URLs. Full source bytes and notices remain intact. Original text research and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, contractual unit matching, remaining form-gated broker layouts, exact visitor entrance, current certified site progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
